task.description:
Implement the process definition module for PD-01 (Create definition) and PD-02 (Graph validation) per the design artefact at src/design/definition.md.

Files to create:
- `src/definition/graph.zig` — pure graph validation (zero I/O, zero allocations except in the validation result buffer). Implements all 8 named checks from the design: CHK-01 (one START), CHK-02 (≥1 END), CHK-03 (no dangling edges), CHK-04 (no isolated nodes), CHK-05 (no duplicate node IDs), CHK-06 (no non-gateway cycles via DFS), CHK-07 (node count ≤500), CHK-08 (edge count ≤2000).
- `src/definition/store.zig` — database CRUD using src/db/pool.zig. Implements: `create()` (inserts row + calls graph.validateGraph() before insert), `getById()`, `list()`. Use parameterised queries only ($1, $2, etc.) — no SQL string interpolation. Handle the unique(name, version) constraint violation as HTTP 409 (DefinitionError.Conflict).

Expose the module via `src/definition.zig` (or `src/definition/mod.zig` per your file structure).

Security rules:
- NO SQL string interpolation. All user-supplied values go through positional parameters.
- No secrets in source.

Validation after implementation:
1. `zig build` MUST exit 0
2. `zig build test` MUST exit 0

Note on file naming: the design uses store.zig + graph.zig; if the backend guide uses different names, prefer the design names (store.zig, graph.zig) — the guide was written before this module was scoped.
acceptance_criteria: src/definition/graph.zig exists with validateGraph() implementing all 8 CHK-* checks
src/definition/store.zig exists with create(), getById(), list()
No SQL string interpolation anywhere in the new files

result.summary: Implemented process definition module: graph.zig (8 CHK checks: CHK-01 through CHK-08, including DFS cycle detection with gateway bypass) and store.zig (create/getById/list with parameterised SQL only). Module exposed via src/definition.zig. Tests added to build.zig as definition_tests. All acceptance criteria met.
